name: lightbox-grid
title: Lightbox Grid
description: A grid of tiles that opens into a full-screen viewer with previous/next, arrow keys, Escape and a focus trap. Opens without scaling under reduced motion.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; label: string; thumb: ReactNode; content?: ReactNode }[]
props.description: The tiles. content is the large view and defaults to thumb.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the open item's index, or null when the viewer closes.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
